posts.title: Summer: The Shuttered Season
posts.description: Even those whose lives blossom under the heat of a coastal sun can become ambivalent about summer’s realities. Eagerly anticipated through winter’s dormancy, desired for its warmth and coveted for its beauty, Gulf Coast summers inevitably end as a season of imprisonment.
